thread:
alex: Quick Q — I opened a small PR that updates CODEOWNERS to add a new path under runtime/serving/plugins and also renames a couple of infra config files. Who's allowed to approve this? Don't want to accidentally bypass anyone. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/642 :eyes:

julia: Pinged the owners listed in the file but they all rotated out last month. If it's only adding the plugin path, area owners for runtime should be fine. If the infra config rename affects staging prod deploys we should get infra team's signoff.

sam: Can you paste the diff? If it's just CODEOWNERS entries and a rename that updates references, I'd say runtime owners + one infra review. If you changed k8s manifests, full infra review.

alex: paste of the changed paths:
```
M  CODEOWNERS (added) /runtime/serving/plugins/ @runtime-team
R  infra/k8s/staging-config.yaml -> infra/k8s/staging-configs/serving.yaml
```
No manifest schema changes, just moving files and updating references.

maria: For CODEOWNERS edits we usually let the codeowners group approve, but since the file affects both runtime and infra, rule of thumb is at least one runtime owner + one infra reviewer. If the runtime-team owner is the only approver in CODEOWNERS, ask them to ack and add an infra reviewer in the PR description.

ajulia: @sam can you approve the infra side if it looks safe? Otherwise tag @infra oncall or @infra-bot to run the quick deploy-checker.

sam: Happy to take a look. Running a quick local smoke check now, will reply in ~15. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: automated check — no k8s schema drift detected, no secrets changed, deploy hooks OK. (report id: cbf-20230718-77)

alex: Thanks. I'll add an explicit approvers list in the PR and ping runtime owners. If sam gives the infra ack, I'll merge after approval window (give people 24h to chime in).

maria: Sounds good. Also add a short changelog entry in PR body to explain why CODEOWNERS changed (rotation + new plugin subdir). Avoid surprise for other teams.

sam: Looks safe on infra side, approved my portion. :white_check_mark:

julia: I'll approve runtime part when the runtime owner group confirms or one of the leads gives an explicit ack.

alex: tagged @runtime-leads and updated PR with notes + changelog. Thanks everyone. :shipit:
